_meta.how: Google: the Google Ads Help pages named in 'source' (read on the checked_on date). Meta: Meta's Ads Guide for the Feed image ad (4:5, 1440x1800, 27-char headline, 50-150 char primary text) plus a third-party 2026 placement table for the rest. Platforms change these without notice - ads.py lint treats Google text limits as hard (the Ads UI rejects them) and Meta text lengths as guidance (the UI accepts longer text and truncates it).
_meta.refresh: Re-read the 'source' pages, edit this file, bump 'checked_on'. ads.py reads only this file for limits, so nothing else needs to change.

rsa.label: Responsive search ad
notes: Assets are shown in any order and any mix; each must read alone and in every combination.
Pinning to H1/H2/D1 guarantees the text shows; H3/D2 is not guaranteed. Pinning cuts combinations and can lower Ad Strength - pin only what must always show.
A line that must appear in every ad (a disclaimer) is pinned to H1, H2 or D1.
Double-width characters (Korean, Japanese, Chinese) count as 2.

pmax.label: Performance Max asset group
notes: Business name must match the domain name or the legally verified business name (Advertiser Verification).

primary_text.note: Feed shows about 125 characters before 'See more'; Meta's Ads Guide suggests 50-150. The first sentence must carry the message on its own.

headline.note: Feed shows about 27 characters; up to ~40 can appear on some placements before it is cut.

description.note: Often not shown at all on mobile feed; never put anything essential here.

meta.cta_note: Platform button labels, set in the ad UI. The list that actually appears depends on the objective and the account.

meta_feed_4x5.label: Meta Feed 4:5 (Facebook + Instagram)
meta_feed_4x5.note: Meta's Ads Guide recommends 1440x1800 for 4:5; 1080 on the short side is the floor. Instagram's profile grid shows the middle 3:4, so keep the side margins.

meta_square_1x1.label: Meta Square 1:1 (Feed, carousel card, right column, Marketplace)
meta_square_1x1.note: Carousel cards are cropped to 1:1 (2-10 cards) - never design a 4:5 carousel card.

meta_story_9x16.label: Meta Stories + Reels 9:16 (Instagram + Facebook)
meta_story_9x16.note: Safe zone: nothing within the top 14% (profile bar) or the bottom 35% (Reels caption + buttons; Stories only needs 20%). One file serves both.

meta_link_landscape.label: Meta link ad 1.91:1 (Feed link, Audience Network)
meta_link_landscape.note: Legacy landscape link card; still used by link ads and some placements.

google_landscape.label: Google landscape image 1.91:1 (Display, PMax, Demand Gen)
google_landscape.note: Google crops images for some placements - keep the headline inside the middle.

google_square.label: Google square image 1:1 (Display, PMax, Demand Gen)

google_portrait.label: Google portrait image 4:5 (PMax, Demand Gen; optional)

google_vertical_9x16.label: Google vertical image 9:16 (Demand Gen on YouTube Shorts; optional)
google_vertical_9x16.note: Google says the safe zones match 9:16 video (YouTube Shorts).

google_logo_square.label: Google logo 1:1
google_logo_square.note: Demand Gen: min 144x144 and 150 KB max. Solid navy ground - Google advises against mostly-white logos on a transparent background.

uploaded_display.route: wm-web-banners builds these (with a button, a GIF if wanted, the 150 KB ceiling).
